rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a chart showing data.

example.english: This graph clearly shows the sales for each month this year.
example.traditional: 呢張圖表清楚顯示今年每個月嘅銷量。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tou4 biu2 cing1 co2 hin2 si6 gam1 nin4 mui5 go3 jyut6 ge3 siu1 loeng6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the plotted representation of a mathematical function.

example.english: The graph of this equation is a straight line.
example.traditional: 呢條方程式嘅函數圖像係一條直線。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fong1 cing4 sik1 ge3 haam4 sou3 tou4 zoeng6 hai6 jat1 tiu4 zik6 sin3

rows.note: Use this in graph theory for a structure of vertices or nodes joined by edges, rather than for an ordinary chart.

example.english: In graph theory, this graph has six vertices.
example.traditional: 喺圖論入面，呢個圖有六個頂點。
example.jyutping: hai2 tou4 leon6 jap6 min6 ni1 go3 tou4 jau5 luk6 go3 deng2 dim2
